stdout:
Build kit for "filter bar above the table"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
Matches the idea. Scaffold it, then replace its content. Keep its layout and spacing.

name:        table-filter
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Flat row collection built around progressive filtering: a token bar that escalates into full query syntax, saved views that persist a filter set, column and grouping options, and a resizable detail pane.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template table-filter --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install lucide-react@"^1.18.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        table-tree
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Hierarchical table where every parent row rolls up from its children - a code repository whose folders show the newest commit beneath them, beside a detail sidebar and a rendered README.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template table-tree --type page <path>

name:        table-page
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Flat table of uniform rows under a block of record-level facts, narrowed three ways at once - a full-text search box, a scope toggle, and per-column popovers - with sortable and filterable columns, per-row hover detail, and totals derived from the visible rows that flag themselves as partial while a filter is on.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template table-page --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: table-filter (@astryxdesign/core), table-grouped (@astryxdesign/core), table-page (@astryxdesign/core).

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        ToolbarTableFilter
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Filter bar above a table: a search box leads the row, each field beside it is a closed trigger that doubles as its own filter chip - the bare field name unset, the whole clause once set - and the clauses fold from the end into a count as the row narrows, followed by a live result count, a clear all, and a column picker.

name:        usePowerSearchConfigHookUsage
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A people directory with a PowerSearch bar over a Table: typed field definitions feed usePowerSearchConfig, returning the search config and an...

name:        PowerSearchSearchWithTable
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Composition of PowerSearch with Table using usePowerSearchConfig to auto-generate config and filter data.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover (top 3 of 6; --verbose for all). Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>
